text.en: This Order may be cited as the Price Control (Display of Prices) Order. Display of price on goods.

(1) Any person who sells by retail any goods or classes of goods specified in the Schedule shall exhibit clearly and conspicuously the price demanded by him for the sale of such goods by means of price tags.

(2) Where any goods or classes of goods are sold by reference to any measurement or unit, such price tags shall clearly indicate the measure or unit in Romanised Malay.

(3) The Price Controller may, by written notice to any person who sells by retail any goods or classes of goods specified in the Schedule require such person to exhibit clearly and conspicuously such particulars as the Price Controller may require in such notice.

SCHEDULE (paragraph 2(1) and (3))

GOODS AND CLASSES OF GOODS
Electrical appliances of all kinds and spare parts therefor. 4 CAP. 142, O 1 Price Control SCHEDULE — (continued)
Sundry goods of all kinds with the exception of photographic equipment of all kinds and spare parts therefor.
